title: Settling a Held Prescription at the Counter on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Plan
content:
Where a pharmacy is holding a prescription for a member of a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan, the member is quoted what they must hand over, pays it, and the fill is priced and released.

What the member pays at the counter is not fixed before the out-of-pocket total standing on the drug plan enrollment agrees with what the pharmacy record shows the member has borne for the contract year. While the total the enrollment carries and the total the pharmacy record bears out are at odds, the figure the member is quoted is not yet fixed.

What the member pays at the counter for a fill on a tier the plan enforces prior authorisation on is not fixed until an approved coverage determination for that product stands on the member's coverage determination record, good through a day not earlier than the fill date. Until such an approval stands on the record, and stands good through a day not earlier than the fill date, the figure for such a fill is not yet fixed.

## Taking the payment and releasing the fill

The fill is settled with `settle_counter_fill_eaef344a`. The agent unlocks it and hands it over for the customer themselves to run, so that the member pays for the prescription the pharmacy is holding at the sum they have been quoted. A priced fill is then recorded against the drug plan enrollment showing what the member handed over and what the plan meets, carrying the reference of the held fill it settles and the reference of the coverage determination on the member's record that covers the product; the member walks away with the medicine and a till receipt.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pdp_enrollment_id` | the reference number of the stand-alone Part D drug plan enrollment the fill is priced under, read from the member's enrollment record | an identifier |
| `customer_id` | the member reference number of the person paying for the prescription, read from their member profile | an identifier |
| `pdp_pharmacy_claim_id` | the reference number of the fill the pharmacy is holding and which this payment settles, read from the member's pharmacy claim records | an identifier |
| `pdp_determination_id` | the reference number of the approved coverage determination on the member's coverage determination record that covers this product, read from the member's coverage determination records | an identifier |
| `negotiated_price` | the price the plan has negotiated for this fill, copied from the held fill | in USD rounded to 2 decimal places, half-up at the point of writing; never left empty |
| `member_paid_amount` | the sum the member hands over at the counter | in USD as a figure of nothing or more rounded to 2 decimal places, half-up at the point of writing; never left empty and never negative |

### Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text carrying the new priced fill's reference number, the drug plan enrollment reference number, the amount in USD the member handed over, the amount in USD the plan meets, and the reference number of the held fill it settles. A sentence of this shape means the fill is priced and released; any other text means nothing was priced and no money was taken.
